elements.requirement: Where the Equality Act 2010 imposes a duty to make reasonable adjustments on a person, that person is referred to as A, and section 20, sections 21 and 22, and the applicable Schedule apply.
elements.quote: a person on whom the duty is imposed is referred to as A

elements.requirement: The duty to make reasonable adjustments imposed on person A comprises three specific requirements.
elements.quote: The duty comprises the following three requirements.

elements.requirement: Under the first requirement, where a provision, criterion or practice of person A's puts a disabled person at a substantial disadvantage in relation to a relevant matter in comparison with persons who are not disabled, person A must take such steps as it is reasonable to have to take to avoid the disadvantage.
elements.quote: to take such steps as it is reasonable to have to take to avoid the disadvantage

elements.requirement: Under the second requirement, where a physical feature puts a disabled person at a substantial disadvantage in relation to a relevant matter in comparison with persons who are not disabled, person A must take such steps as it is reasonable to have to take to avoid the disadvantage.
elements.quote: where a physical feature puts a disabled person at a substantial disadvantage in relation to a relevant matter in comparison with persons who are not disabled

elements.requirement: Under the third requirement, where a disabled person would, but for the provision of an auxiliary aid, be put at a substantial disadvantage in relation to a relevant matter in comparison with persons who are not disabled, person A must take such steps as it is reasonable to have to take to provide the auxiliary aid.
elements.quote: to take such steps as it is reasonable to have to take to provide the auxiliary aid

elements.requirement: Where the first or third requirement relates to the provision of information, the steps which it is reasonable for person A to have to take include steps for ensuring that in the circumstances concerned the information is provided in an accessible format.
elements.quote: the steps which it is reasonable for A to have to take include steps for ensuring that in the circumstances concerned the information is provided in an accessible format

elements.requirement: A person A who is subject to a duty to make reasonable adjustments is not entitled, subject to express provision to the contrary, to require a disabled person in relation to whom person A is required to comply with the duty to pay to any extent person A's costs of complying with the duty.
elements.quote: not (subject to express provision to the contrary) entitled to require a disabled person, in relation to whom A is required to comply with the duty, to pay to any extent A's costs of complying with the duty

elements.requirement: A reference in section 21, section 22, or an applicable Schedule to the first, second, or third requirement must be construed in accordance with section 20.
elements.quote: A reference in section 21 or 22 or an applicable Schedule to the first, second or third requirement is to be construed in accordance with this section.

elements.requirement: In relation to the second requirement, a reference in section 20 or an applicable Schedule to avoiding a substantial disadvantage includes removing the physical feature in question, altering it, or providing a reasonable means of avoiding it.
elements.quote: removing the physical feature in question, (b) altering it, or (c) providing a reasonable means of avoiding it

elements.requirement: A reference in section 20, section 21, section 22, or an applicable Schedule (apart from paragraphs 2 to 4 of Schedule 4) to a physical feature means a feature arising from the design or construction of a building, a feature of an approach to, exit from or access to a building, a fixture or fitting, or furniture, furnishings, materials, equipment or other chattels, in or on premises, or any other physical element or quality.
elements.quote: apart from paragraphs 2 to 4 of Schedule 4

elements.requirement: A reference in section 20, section 21, section 22, or an applicable Schedule to an auxiliary aid includes a reference to an auxiliary service.
elements.quote: A reference in this section, section 21 or 22 or an applicable Schedule to an auxiliary aid includes a reference to an auxiliary service.

elements.requirement: A reference in section 20 or an applicable Schedule to chattels must be read, in relation to Scotland, as a reference to moveable property.
elements.quote: to chattels is to be read, in relation to Scotland, as a reference to moveable property

elements.requirement: The applicable Schedule is Schedule 2 for Part 3 (services and public functions), Schedule 4 for Part 4 (premises), Schedule 8 for Part 5 (work), Schedule 13 for Part 6 (education), Schedule 15 for Part 7 (associations), and Schedule 21 for each of those mentioned Parts.
elements.quote: The applicable Schedule is, in relation to the Part of this Act specified in the first column of the Table, the Schedule specified in the second column.
